The '''Heavy Y-wing''' was a larger scale [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing]] [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It possessed four engine pods rather than just two.<ref name="SW:GB" /> Four of the Heavy Y-wings were deployed in the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Seizure of Coruscant]] as part of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] strike force.<ref name="GB:CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Heavy Y-wings appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.
